easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
